package.name: sil_fusion_adapter
package.description: SIL→L3 fusion relay (C++). Replaces the SIL→L3 portion of sil_topic_bridge.py (Track A A5). Pure field-mapping: sil_msgs/TargetVesselState (single) → l3_external_msgs/TrackedTargetArray (1-elem array), and sil_msgs/EnvironmentState → l3_external_msgs/EnvironmentState (m/s→kn unit conversion). No behavior logic.
